caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a vase or jar, centered on a plain beige background. The vessel has a bulbous body that curves outward from a narrow neck and then tapers back in towards a flared base. The neck features two pronounced, rounded ridges near the top, and the open mouth is circular. The main body of the vase is predominantly dark brown, with streaks and patches of lighter brown, tan, and muted yellow tones, giving it a mottled appearance. The base of the jar has a yellowish, marbled effect that contrasts with the darker hues on the rest of the vessel. In the lower right-hand corner of the beige background, there is a handwritten signature reading "Richard Barnett." No other objects or decorations are present in the composition.
title: Asthma Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
